question: How many of the 300,000 SAT takers wrote in about the error?
answer: Only three of the 300,000 SAT takers wrote in about the error: Shivan Kartha, Bruce Taub and Doug Jungreis. Everyone else trusted the test over their own reasoning. The card's lesson is to speak up when an answer looks wrong.
move: If an answer looks wrong to you, say so: almost nobody else will.
